Messages.Author: Wouter Kuyper
Messages.Body:
Hi all,
I was looking for some nice cards to combine with Gisela's Ability...
I came up with draught of the soul, but i assume it only works on the
non-superior version right (since there has to be a controller)...

and ritual of the bitter rose..."either by diablerie or while in
combat with this vampire.", is this meant to clarify which options of
burning-during-action there were at the time of publishing, or is this
really meant to prohibit someone (me) from using it with Gisela's
action? (i guess it is the latter..darn)

Are there some options/funny-things i didn't see?

Wouter

(all texts from the ELDB)
Gisela Hrden

Sabbat Priscus: Gisela can burn a vampire in your prey's uncontrolled
region as a (D) action that costs X blood, where X is the amount of
blood on that vampire; any blood on that vampire is returned to your
prey's pool.

Draught of the soul

Only usable when this acting vampire burns another vampire. [qui]:
This vampire gains 1 blood. [aus][qui]: This vampire gains 1 blood.
Put this card on this vampire. The vampire with this card has +1
intercept. [AUS][QUI]: As [aus][qui] above, and this vampire gets +1
bleed when bleeding the controller of the burned vampire.

Riual of the Bitter Rose

This card can be played as an action modifier card or a combat card.
Each ready vampire you control gains an amount of blood from the blood
bank equal to the amount of blood on a vampire being burned either by
diablerie or while in combat with this vampire.
